Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the establishment of a single portal for Washington businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the establishment of a single portal forWashington businesses; and adding a new section to chapter 43.41A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.41A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The chief information officer must establish an integratedenterprise system using a single portal, accessible through theinternet, to: (a) Allow access to state government records; (b) Permit the electronic filing of all documents required by astate agency; (c) Permit the payment of all taxes and fees; (d) Provide information, services, and resources for: (i) Starting, expanding, and operating a business in Washington orrelocating a business within or to Washington; (ii) Understanding state and local government rules, ordinances,and policies that apply to business; (iii) Registering, licensing, and obtaining needed permits for abusiness; p. 1 ESSB 6356 (iv) Obtaining information about and assistance with exporting,public contracting, hiring, and training; and (v) Obtaining information about financing and tax credits availableto businesses; and (e) Enable convenient access to information from all agencies ofstate government that have functions related to business registration,licensing, permitting, or taxation or that otherwise can provideinformation for or assist with establishing, expanding, operating, orrelocating a business. (2) The chief information officer must consider the potential for: (a) Private sector involvement in establishing and providing accessto the portal; and (b) Lowering costs through private sector delivery of the portaland attendant services. (3) The single portal for Washington businesses must be implementedby January 1, 2013.
